topics.topic: Whether to remove all former staff email-challenge routes and revise the backend route count and closure, or retain the referenced 56-route backend
questions: Must the current rules.http_router_backend omit every former email-verification, email-change, and password-reset route, with its route count and closure revised, or must the referenced 56-route backend still be implemented?

witness.initial: The service is assembled from the current module set after the staff challenge module and its operations have been removed.
events: The deployment process starts the service and module:api.create_app binds the rows of rules.http_router_backend.
An external API caller requests one of the former email-verification, email-change or password-reset routes.
outcomes: Following State 4, the former challenge route is absent and the request receives the ordinary unmatched-route response.
Following State 2, the unchanged 56-route backend requires the former route to be bound, so it either matches without an owning operation or prevents route assembly.
witness.observer: The API caller or the deployer assembling the service.
basis: The deployment process starts the service, and later a monitor or proxy asks for liveness or readiness (R0-10, R0-11).

A route handler extracts the credential and the declared request body, calls exactly one owning use case and returns its result or a safe projection of it; it decides nothing, retries nothing and writes no audit.

On 2026-11-07 the owner removed the staff email challenges (`00_product.md`
R0-23). Three modules leave with them: `staff_challenges` (added by the
Factory), the repository `email_delivery_repository` (one of the eleven) and
`email_delivery_gateway` (one of the former 20). The case runs 36 modules: 19
of the former text and 17 added ones, ten of them repositories.
- **No email challenges (former F2)**: deferred in the accepted spec, removed by the owner on 2026-11-07 with their routes (R0-23); onboarding is the administrator activation (R0-19).

- `rules.http_router_backend` (56 routes, Factory `300bd11d` … `a6916180314d`)
  — router closure and router context (`70_router_closure.json`,
  `70_router_context.json`).
